methods: Retained CRISPRidentify, FASTA36 and cmscan outputs; matching requires same contig/strand, >=20 nt and >=50% shorter interval. Alternate BLAST uses identical identity/coverage gates and masks. Both repeat orientations are queried. Isolated-reference alignments use known truth and are diagnostic only.
limits: Absence of a cmscan table hit does not prove biological absence of a family. Scores and candidate counts are not calibrated precision estimates. No parameters or models were fitted to these references.

partial_boundary_rescues.label: Lan
partial_boundary_rescues.explanation: The CM identifies a conserved subregion. No passing anti-repeat supplies an oriented extension window; the rescue reports only model-supported coordinates and does not assert complete transcript boundaries.

II.membership: Canonical catalog membership: II, II-* or unknown for the Type II screen; V or V-* for Type V. Type III and VI are excluded. Both retained scan batches are joined by sequence hash; the first batch wins duplicate hashes.
II.caveat: E-values depend on search space: this pooled sequence scan is not a calibration of the per-genome rescue E-value. Mononucleotide shuffled sequences are not verified biological negatives.
